A common strategy in such auctions is to bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive profit if I win. Given my value is $9, I will bid $8.9. Given my value is $34, I want to bid strategically to maximize profit. In an ascending clock auction with sealed bids, the optimal strategy is often to bid your true value. This ensures that if I win, I pay no more than my value, guaranteeing a non-negative profit. Bidding below my value risks losing the item for a price I would have been willing to pay.
